method.ipv4_checksum: One's-complement 16-bit sum over the entire captured IPv4 header, including stored checksum; correct iff 0xffff.
method.tcp_checksum: IPv4 pseudoheader plus full IPv4-declared TCP segment, including stored checksum; correct iff 0xffff. Odd byte padded with zero only for summation.
method.unverifiable: Fragments are not reassembled. Missing declared segment bytes and malformed lengths are reported as unverifiable, never as bad checksums.
method.partial_seed_check: Compare stored TCP checksum with folded pseudoheader sum separately; this is diagnostic evidence, not checksum validation.
method.matching: Fixed 38 packet candidates, exact bidirectional tuple and inclusive observed packet envelope; per-direction packet counts asserted against frozen catalog.

semantic_decision.criterion: Capture-host TX checksum offload enabled, every outgoing bad checksum equals the partial pseudoheader seed, complete valid IPv4/segment lengths, independent sequence-number handshakes and ACKs, and exact strict/ignore packet-and-byte conservation.
semantic_decision.strict_role: checksum-filtered diagnostic, not an alternative interchangeable model input
semantic_decision.scope: These 38 audited cloud-side packet candidates; not automatic clearance of other hosts, captures, or the whole-capture length anomalies.
